tools.name: list_nodes
tools.title: List sovereign nodes
tools.description: List all declared sovereign mesh nodes in the cMAP fleet with region, role, tier, declared purpose, and public probe endpoint. Requires an active cMAP MCP subscription.

tools.name: list_blades
tools.title: List OMNI-SAM AXIS blades
tools.description: List the 13 canonical OMNI-SAM AXIS blades of cMAP with status (LIVE, STANDBY, AWAITING), sovereign route, and tagline. Requires an active cMAP MCP subscription.

tools.name: centralization_inventory
tools.title: Centralization inventory
tools.description: Return the honest inventory of every non-sovereign dependency the cMAP browser app has (analytics, fonts, host, probes), the removable status of each, and the migration path to sovereignty. Requires an active cMAP MCP subscription.

tools.name: provenance_record
tools.title: Record provenance stamp
tools.description: Record a SHA-256 hash as a provenance stamp attributed to the calling user. Fast, no external calls. Starter tier: 1,000 stamps/month. Pro tier: unlimited + per-stamp HMAC-signed webhook delivery to configured endpoints. Requires an active subscription.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the artifact to stamp.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the artifact.

tools.name: provenance_ots_stamp
tools.title: OTS-stamp provenance hash
tools.description: Submit a SHA-256 hash to public OpenTimestamps calendars for Bitcoin anchoring, then record the calendar receipts on the caller's account. Starter tier: 1,000 stamps/month. Pro tier: unlimited + per-stamp HMAC-signed webhook delivery. Requires an active subscription.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the artifact to stamp.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the artifact.
